<details open>

llama : keep the k-pool layout prefix on sequence edits (#32137)

* llama : keep the k-pool layout prefix on sequence edits

Assisted-by: Claude Code

* llama : address review of the k-pool layout update

* Append and edit share one branch, using stale > sq.pos_min.
* LLAMA_KPOOL_VERIFY=1 checks every update against a full rebuild. The scan moved into kpool_scan() so the check can reuse it.
* The test turns the check on for its rollback context, skips -sm tensor, and drops kimi-k31.
* Two comments that were no longer true are fixed.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

* llama : check the k-pool layout update in debug builds instead of LLAMA_KPOOL_VERIFY

* llama : remove the k-pool layout verification

* llama : inline the k-pool scan again

* remove dangling new line

* do not search twice

---------

Co-authored-by: Aman Gupta <amangupta052@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Alexey Kopytko <alexey@kopytko.com>

</details>
